Name: Anthro Lannah
Author: Emreld3000
Description:
This is a Portraits and Sprites mod for Lannah/Lance so that she fits in with the characters from Anthro Characters Continued/FurrySVE!

BetasEnjoyer11 originally created a portrait art for Elliott's genderswap from ACC, which nevber got used. I've repurposed that portrait for use with Lannah to make her ACC-compatible. I picked her for this due to the natural association of wizards and lions. With Nom0ri's and BetasEnjoyer11's permission, I adapted Lannah's clothing and crafted sprites for her using Lannah's sprites, Ellen's sprites from ACC, and AdarinSinner's Elliott sprites from their StardewValley_GIRL mod.

This is a standard Content Patcher mod. Install it like you would any other.

 This mod only features Lannah's Normal, Winter, and Beach outfits. This means Lannah has fewer outfits than before. However, this should still be enough to make Lannah feel complete. Please turn of Seasonal and Festival outfits in "Lannah - Female Lance" when using this mod. For funsies Lannah uses her Beach outfit at the sauna or the Pelican Town beach if you somehow get here there.

This is the second in a series of projects meant to utilize anthro artworks that would otherwise not be simultaneously used with each other, or otherwise unused. The first part of this project was Quinn, which you can see here: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50464

[b]Requirements[/b]
"Lannah - Female Lance" and "Furry Stardew Valley Expanded Continued" are required
I would highly suggest using this mod alongside "Anthro Characters Continued", but its not literally necessary
